en: A vintage black and white photograph showing a large group of women in swimsuits and bathing caps on a sandy beach. Some of them are sitting or lying on towels, while others stand or sit in wicker beach chairs. Behind them is a building with a large balcony and round windows, surrounded by dense pine forest. A flagpole and a flag with what appears to be Scandinavian-style cross designs are visible. The left edge of the postcard has the word 'FREUNA' vertically.
